summary: Added build_app and init_app_state for fresh Engine-bound ASGI apps. Request-scoped state dispatch keeps native and OpenAI routes isolated between app instances without changing the compatibility module global, and the single-tokenizer launch_server path now uses the same factory construction.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at the recorded base: the proposed public factory functions did not exist. Raw output: evidence/factory_import_before.log
31 tests and 12 subtests passed, including concurrent isolation of two fresh apps on an existing native route and compatibility-global preservation. Raw output: evidence/focused-tests.log

A real prepared Engine was bound with build_app/init_app_state and served /model_info plus an eight-token /generate request through ASGI TestClient; owned descendants were reaped. Raw output: evidence/engine-app.log and evidence/engine-app/result.json
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, and registered-test policy checks.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 executed the deterministic tiny Llama and returned output_ids [12, 100, 124, 43, 124, 43, 124, 51].

remaining_limitations: build_app intentionally supports the in-process Engine single-tokenizer configuration; multi-tokenizer HTTP workers still require launch_server shared-memory bootstrap.
The deterministic random tiny Llama validates transport and engine execution only, not semantic quality, other model architectures, or distributed workloads.
SGLang runtime configuration remains process-wide independently of this ASGI state fix; the isolation regression uses compatible server arguments for both app instances.
